title: fix(export-xlsx): OOXML interop — autofilter overlap, Methodology header, serial dates, bounded sums, proof links
body:
## Summary

Second round of OOXML interop repairs, covering three native-Excel findings on `3e033f4`: the autoFilter overlap that stripped tables 1–3 and table4's records filter, KPI formulas that recalculated to 0 or all-month totals, and proof hyperlinks landing on the wrong Methodology rows.

## AutoFilter overlap (the repair dialog's `Removed Feature AutoFilter and Table`)

Each data sheet set a **worksheet-level** `autoFilter` on the exact range its table's own filter covers — Excel strips the whole table feature for the overlap. Removed the three redundant `sheet.autoFilter` assignments; the table-internal filters (refs already corrected by the post-package pass) remain the real filter UI.

Methodology's headerless table (`headerRowCount="0"`) couldn't host a records filter. It now writes a localized header row (`table.field`/`table.value`, `styleHeaderRow`) at row 1 — table is `A1:B27`/`headerRowCount="1"`, filter legal.

## Formula correctness (B2/B3→0, B8/B9→all-month totals)

- **Serial dates:** Cleaned Data wrote ISO date strings; `SUMIFS` compared them against numeric `DATE()` criteria → 0. Date-typed columns (`column.type === 'date'`, works for custom uploads too) now write real `Date` values with `yyyy-mm-dd` display format.
- **Period bounds:** all-region metrics used `SUM(whole column)` ignoring the model's period — June revenue recalculated to 23.5M. They now emit `SUMIFS` with both `DATE()` bounds and no region criterion. Missing region/date columns on custom data degrade to no formula (cached value stands) rather than a broken reference.

## Proof links (`9+i` stale offset)

`proofRowOf` hardcoded 8 fixed rows + headerless sheet; the real layout is 10 fixed rows + a header — links landed on Template/Locale. `methodRows` is now built before the KPI pass and links derive from the actual row math (`proofStartIndex + i + 2`), verified per-metric.

## Regression coverage

A bounded recalc engine in the test parses the packaged workbook (shared strings, sheets via workbook.xml+rels) and evaluates **every emitted formula** — `SUMIFS`/`SUM`/`IF`/`DATE`, sheet-qualified ranges, comparisons, `&` concat — against the model oracle, EN and AR, over the multi-month fixture (whole-column bugs now produce provably wrong values). Asserts: serial date cells (not `t="s"`), no bare `SUM(`, zero worksheet-level `autoFilter`, `headerRowCount="1"` + matching filter refs, each KPI/summary proof link lands on its intended `Proof {id}`/إثبات label.

## Verified on rebuilt EN+AR workbooks

- Formulas evaluate to the oracle: B2=881000, B3=1000000, B8=6,000,000, B9=4,500,000, B13=1,500,000, B14=25%.
- No `<autoFilter>` in any sheet XML; `legacyDrawing` before `tableParts`; all four table parts valid.
- LibreOffice renders the full 223-page workbook. **Native-Excel retest remains with the owner** — LibreOffice and the in-test evaluator are proxies, not Excel proof.

## Checks

887 vitest, eslint, tsc — clean.
